params.text: Select all neurons associated with the fly's central complex (CX).

Fetch connections between the central complex neurons and turn them into a network.

N.B. that we're aggregating individual neurons into their cell types!
Network analyses are split into two nodes: "Network Metrics" and "Network Centrality". The latter is much more expensive to compute on large graphs which is why it's a separate node.

Type-to-type network with nodes colored by community. 

N.B. that there is an active filter that removes weak(ish) connections.
